FAQ.SUBTITLE: Find answers to the most frequently asked questions about our managed services offers.
FAQ.TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions

Q1.A: Managed maintenance services refers to the partial or total delegation of your maintenance operations management to an external provider. This includes strategy, processes, tools, and the resources needed to keep your assets in optimal working condition.

Q2.A: Our Starter offer is recommended for organizations starting their transformation or looking for guidance in defining their strategy. Standard and Émérite offers are suited for organizations seeking more advanced operational delegation.
Q2.Q: How do I choose the right offer for my organization?

Q3.A: Yes, our offers are designed to scale. You can start with the Free or Starter offer, then upgrade to Standard or Émérite as your maturity and needs grow.
Q3.Q: Can we move from one offer to another?

Q4.A: Yes, the Free offer gives you access to the Elite Maintenance platform at no cost. Paid offers (Starter, Standard, Émérite) include increasing levels of support and services. Contact us for a quote tailored to your situation.
Q4.Q: Is the Free offer truly free?

Q5.A: With the Émérite offer, a dedicated team works closely with your teams, either on-site or remotely. We provide continuous oversight of the maintenance strategy and ongoing performance- and reliability-driven improvement.
Q5.Q: How does the strategic partnership in the Émérite offer work?
